title: Inventory classification of one engine
description: Classifies every item of inventory/<engine>/*.yaml. Rules are tried in order; the first rule with a matching pattern (fnmatch on the item id) wins. Keywords contained in keywords/<engine>/<version>.yaml count as covered without a rule.

status.description: covered: described by the given specs. planned: a roadmap item will cover it. out-of-scope: deliberately not described (reason required). open: belongs in scope, not described yet (reason says what is missing).

specs.description: For covered: <kind>:<id> (syntax:query.fulltext-select, capability:..., operation:..., query:..., lexical:..., engine:...).
